**install** → `Add Instance` → `Import from zip` → the URL below
**launch** → the pre-launch step syncs the pack, every time
**join** → `/whitelist add <your minecraft name>`, then connect
**update** → nothing. A pack release lands on your next launch.

### what the pre-launch command does
Prism runs this before every launch, and importing the instance is what agrees to it:
```
$INST_JAVA -cp packwiz-installer.jar \n  link.infra.packwiz.installer.Main -s client <pack url>
```
It downloads what changed and deletes what was removed — that is the whole auto-update mechanism. The jar is **committed and pinned** at `c9f6469…` and CI refuses to build the zip if a byte moves; it is never fetched from the internet at launch. The `.mrpack` on the pack page is the manual alternative.
